gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-stack-sans-notc: Noodle-thin strokes of uniform width define Funnel Display. Stack Sans Notch follows with big-bodied lowercase and open curves, so a long block of text stays easy on the eye.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans: Audiowide looks like glass tubing bent into letters, with tall lowercase and tile-like spacing. Noto Sans keeps its lowercase full and its c wide open, doing the quiet work of plain sans text that Audiowide would never attempt.
gen-almendra-display-gf-anek-kannada: Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary flavor, its letters never pinching shut and its x-height standing tall. Anek Kannada, a modern sans, answers with squared-off height.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-sulphur-point: Fat, friendly, and loud: Autour One flows into every round letter without any hairline shift. Sulphur Point then handles the plain sans job, with bulky lowercase and open gaps that keep the text clear.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-stack-sans-text: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes that never change width. Stack Sans Text underneath holds a marker-like line and big-bodied lowercase, giving the heading plenty of room to lead.
gen-eater-gf-orienta: Dark and snarling, Eater spaces its letters far apart and keeps its ascenders stubby. And Orienta, a modern sans, lets its counters breathe, so it is the one you can read comfortably when the menace is not needed.
gen-flavors-gf-pathway-extreme: Twine-like strokes and a towering x-height give Flavors a whimsical, commanding look, while Pathway Extreme matches that big-lowercase build in a modern plain sans. Both feel stout and sturdy.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-oxygen: Wide, bold lettering with round forms like open parentheses: that is Goldman. Oxygen, a plain sans with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, reads smoothly because its curves never close back on themselves.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Audiowide has no pinched joins or swelling bowls, only futuristic tubing. Noto Sans Adlam supplies the clean counterpoint, with curve endings held well apart and a full, tall c, s and z for steady sans-serif reading.
gen-almendra-display-gf-anek-latin: Letters that refuse to pinch shut mark Almendra Display. Anek Latin sits beside that ornate, literary heading with tall lowercase nearly reaching its capitals, a sans that keeps every shape held open.
